environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed in account 112233445566, VPC-attached with direct MySQL RDS connectivity. API Gateway REST API with no request validation template. Lambda execution role arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/UserSearchLambdaRole has AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess and AmazonRDSDataFullAccess managed policies. No WAF attached to the API Gateway stage.
